name: Jussi Rahkama
headline: Turning complex operations into working systems.
supportingHeadline: Connecting people, technology, processes and business.
summary: I bring approximately 30 years of automotive experience, from vehicle electrical systems and diagnostics to technical training, international manufacturer support, service management and operational transformation.

career.summary: Led Jaguar and Land Rover aftersales turnaround, launched Mazda and Xpeng service operations and prepared new service locations.
Established and developed BMW and MINI service operations, recruited and trained staff and developed an SAP-based communication workflow.
Managed 27 employees with HR responsibility. Led a workshop turnaround and held facility, environmental and quality responsibilities.
Re-established automotive technical training operations in Finland, with a focus on diagnostic equipment and technical competence.
Supported vehicle diagnostics, technical quality monitoring and training in cooperation with the manufacturer and dealer network.
Worked in Martorell, Spain, on international technical support and cooperation among the manufacturer, importers and dealers.
Vehicle electrical systems, diagnostics, product testing, installation instructions, entrepreneurship and technical team leadership in motorsport.

caseStudies.challenge: Turn around Jaguar and Land Rover aftersales while bringing Mazda and Xpeng service operations online.
caseStudies.actions: Developed team structures, operational processes and the customer experience. Prepared new service locations.
caseStudies.results: +26 points in Net Promoter Score (NPS). Mazda and Xpeng service operations launched.

metric.label: NPS points
metric.context: Aftersales turnaround at Inchcape Motors Finland

caseStudies.project: Building BMW and MINI service capacity
caseStudies.challenge: Establish and develop BMW and MINI service operations.
caseStudies.actions: Recruited and trained staff, developed service processes and built an SAP-based communication workflow.
caseStudies.results: Service capacity doubled while maintaining profitability.

metric.label: Service capacity
metric.context: BMW and MINI service at Schmiedmann

caseStudies.project: Clarifying roles in a workshop turnaround
caseStudies.challenge: Improve workshop operations while managing people, facilities and quality responsibilities.
caseStudies.actions: Led a team of 27 employees with HR responsibilities and clarified roles during the turnaround.
caseStudies.results: Defined clearer workshop roles as part of the operational turnaround.

leadership.heading: Make the work clear enough to improve.
leadership.body: I believe people do their best work when they understand what they own, have the skills to do it and can raise problems early. I look at the whole operation, especially the handoffs where information, decisions or responsibility can get lost.

principles.title: Clarify ownership
principles.body: Make responsibilities and handoffs explicit so people know who can make a decision and where to go for support.

principles.title: Build competence
principles.body: Use training and feedback to build confidence in everyday work, from technical diagnosis to customer communication.

principles.title: Improve continuously
principles.body: Observe how the process works in practice, fix recurring friction and use feedback to guide the next change.

development.title: Technology and AI
development.body: My current development areas include vehicle telematics, fleet management and operational ERP and workflow concepts. I use AI-assisted application development to explore how operational requirements can take shape in prototypes and workflow tools.

development.title: Automotive 2.0
development.body: Automotive 2.0 explores future automotive operating models. It asks how service networks can develop technical competence, share operational information and organize work as vehicle technology and customer needs change.

development.title: Autonomous Mobility
development.body: My interest is in the operations that support autonomous fleets, including vehicle readiness, maintenance coordination, escalation and technical training. Aftersales, diagnostics and service-network experience provide a transferable perspective on that work.
